issues.text: The hero memory (The house in Greece, tag-cover.jpg) appears three times on one screen: as the hero, as the thumb of the 'Elena added to your memory' row, and as the first Latest tile. The mockup shows five distinct photos. homeOf returns the same memory as hero, contributed card and latest[0]; latest must exclude the hero (and cards should prefer non-hero memories). This is store logic (select.js homeOf, integrator) but Home is the screen that shows it; until the selector changes Home may filter latest by hero.id.

Empty persona (p3, the real user's first screen) is a Latest label, three dead tiles and 70% empty ground. The tiles do nothing on tap (stack stays [] after tapping .hm-tile, docs/shots/home-crit-emptytile.json) and carry no demo mark although ARCHITECTURE says 'marked demo'. ARCHITECTURE's zero-memory rule conflicts with spec 5.1 ('real captures mixed with demo content') and the roadmap ('the big card and the cards below use demo content'). Needs an integrator decision: either the demo world's hero and rows fill the screen and open, or the demo tiles open via a db merge and get a mark. A screen that is mostly void with dead tiles cannot ship.

At full scroll the raised plus button (54px, lifted 22px above the tab bar) sits on top of the middle Latest tile: tile bottom at y=772, tab bar top at 788. The middle tile can never be seen whole. .hm has padding-bottom 16 on top of the 56px tab bar padding; it needs to clear the lifted button (about 48px, i.e. 22 lift + 16 gap + rounding).

Contract: src/home/index.jsx imports PERSONS and bundledSpace from src/data/personas.js, outside the allowed set (src/core, src/data/select.js, src/data/api.js, src/lib, own folder). Home does its own person lookup and owns the zero-memory demo fallback (data logic that ARCHITECTURE 7 says belongs in the store). Fix: App passes the person or db.people carries the avatar; homeOf returns the demo Latest for an empty persona. No localStorage or window writes found in src/home (clean).

The four 22px stack avatars load 900px memory photos (mem-13, mem-08, tag-leo, mem-11, about 830 KB) because people.avatar_url in the Isabel seed points at full photos. Data seed issue (integrator): point avatar_url at small crops. Home's own hero (281 KB, 823px) and 48/114px thumbs at 900px are acceptable. The rest of the 5.3 MB transfer is the Memories grid and Capture sheet being mounted alongside Home (core, not Home).
Hero card, activity rows and Latest tiles are div onClick with no role=button, tabIndex or key handling; only the play control is a real button. A shipped app makes every tappable card focusable.
Latest label letter-spacing is 0.3px (copied from the mockup CSS) while the label role in spec 2.3 is 0.4px; the row labels use 0.4. Pick one, preferably the token.

home.notes: Full gauntlet: 50 shots, 0 failed, 0 console/page errors, 0 failed requests, slowest ready 1416ms. Measured in the DOM at phone x2: wordmark 700 16px ls -0.3, avatar 30px pill surface, greeting 600 30px/33px ls -0.5, hero 358x322 (4:3.6) radius 24 with the photoScrim, stack avatars 22px with 2px #101014 borders overlapping -8, play 42px white with 16px black filled glyph, title 600 20px/23px, meta 500 12.5px reading '7 people · July 12–19' from data, rows radius 18 padding 9 gap 8 with 48px radius-12 thumbs, label 600 11px ls 0.4, line 400 13.5px, Latest 600 12px, tiles 114px radius 14 gap 8, 12px gap between blocks, 16px edge padding, all text rgb(255,255,255) opacity 1, Geist loaded, no accent, no emoji, copy bank strings verbatim. Side by side with the roadmap Home mockup the hero, stack, play, rows and tiles match to the pixel. Greeting verified for 09:00, 15:00 (own shot) and 21:00. Taps verified via window.__state: play -> recap isa_greece, hero and tile -> story with origin rect, avatar -> sheet 'profile'. Reduced-motion shot renders identically. What keeps it off 8.5 is not the styling but what the screen shows: the same Greece photo three times, the plus button parked on a Latest tile at full scroll, and an empty-persona screen that is mostly void with dead tiles. Two of the four majors (1, 2) need the integrator (homeOf, demo-world merge) and the contract issue (4) needs App to pass the person; the builder can fix 3 and can filter the hero out of Latest locally in the meantime. issues.text: Caption meta lines are clipped mid-glyph instead of ellipsized: 'September 4, 2025 · Valldemos', 'November 8, 2025 · Amsterdar', 'the Berlin fla', 'Tempelhofer Fel', 'Luang Prabar'. .mg-meta is display:flex, and text-overflow: ellipsis never applies to a flex container's anonymous text child, so the nowrap text is just cut at the box edge. Wrap the text in its own span with min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis (keep the flex only for the avatar stack), or drop flex on solo tiles. Visible on roughly a third of tiles in real data and on every square tile with a year plus a long place.

The wide tile's avatar stack opens with a flat surface circle carrying the initial 'I' (Isabel, no avatar_url) followed by two photos; the mockup shows three photo avatars (Elena, Leo, Jonas). It is the most-looked-at element of the screen and the one place it reads as programmer art next to the reference. Show the other people first (sharedOf slice(1)) or prefer people with a photo when filling the three slots; the initial fallback should be the last resort, not the leader.

many scene perf (owner: capture/core, not this module, but it lands on this screen): 250 resources and 9.7 MB transferred, readyMs 2485 on phone x2 morning (threshold 2500), 2326 on phoneSmall x3 evening. The grid itself lazy-loads correctly (241 imgs, 237 lazy) but the closed Capture sheet renders 243 eager thread bubbles (Capture.jsx:681/704) so every photo is fetched anyway. Add loading="lazy" to thread photos or stop rendering the history while the sheet is closed; the memories tab should be ~1 s on Maya.

Tiles give no state feedback on press: .mg-tile has no :active style, so a tap is silent until the 900 ms story grows. Spec 2.7 asks for 200 ms fast feedback on state; a subtle opacity or 0.98 scale on :active over var(--motion-fast) var(--ease) is enough.

Accessible name of the wide tile is 'The house in GreeceI7 people · July 12–19': the avatar initial and stack sit inside .mg-meta and leak into the button's text. Put aria-hidden on .mg-stack (the count already says 7 people).

Wide-format rule is undecided: ARCHITECTURE 5 says owner + at least one other person goes wide, the shipped rule is 'has a contributor link' (so Dinner at Marco's with two tagged people stays square, which matches the mockup). The builder's choice matches the reference and keeps Maya's 241 grid sane (0 wide tiles); the integrator should lock the rule in ARCHITECTURE.md so the next round does not flip it.

issues.text: Signature animation scales the whole story page (header, hero, cards, its own ground) from the tile's top-left instead of growing the photo into the hero. At 150ms a 44% miniature page with a readable-sized header sits over the tile and its black ground already covers the neighbouring tile below (Grandma's laughter is half hidden by a black rectangle), so the tile photo never continues into the hero: the hero lands 30px lower than the tile photo it came from. Fix: animate only the hero image from origin (position/size, fixed radius 18 -> 20) while the header and the blocks below fade or slide in over the same 900ms; the page ground must not scale (paint it via the layer, opacity 0 -> 1). See docs/shots/critic/st-grow-150.png vs st-grow-450.png.

Answering the question is a hard cut. Tapping Save collapses the 330px question card into a 100px 'Saved.' card instantly and the answer text card is inserted above the Related row, so the Related row jumps up 230px with no motion, then the 'Saved.' card vanishes after 2s with another cut. Spec 2.7: content moves, it does not pop. Keep the question card's box, swap its content to 'Saved.' in place (height transition 600ms var(--ease)), then collapse it with motion. docs/shots/critic/st-saved-300.png (Saved.) and st-saved-done.png (after).

The saved answer reads as a stray sentence: 'We talked about the summer in Paros.' lands as an unlabeled surface card between the song row and the Related row, with no trace of the question it answers. In the shared story the same text block gets a 'Sam said' label, in the solo story nothing. Give answer moments a label (the question text at 11/600, or 'What you said' for the viewer's own text) and ask the integrator to place the answer after the song/related rows in storyOf so the story still ends on the person's words. docs/shots/critic/st-saved-done.png.

The 'You' chip and the 'You' photo badge render the initial 'I' on a surfaceDeep circle while the mockup shows a portrait; p5 Isabel has photo: null in src/data/personas.js and avatar_url null in the seed. Data task: give Isabel a portrait so You chips and badges match ref-story-4. docs/shots/story/shared-phone-x2-morning.png.
Photo pair gutter is 10px (.st-pair gap) while every other gap on the page is 12; the mockup uses the same gutter as the block gap. Set 12. docs/shots/story/shared-phone-x2-morning.png.

On phoneSmall the song line truncates to 'Ta Paidia tou Peiraia · Melina Merc…' because the 44px chevron hit target eats the row. Let the line wrap to two lines (or shrink the chevron's reserved width to 32) so the artist is never cut. docs/shots/story/shared-end-phoneSmall-x3-evening.png.
Labels (.st-lbl) use letter-spacing 0.5px; the label role in spec 2.3 is 0.4. Also the label/song text card line-height is 1.4 where body is 1.45. docs/shots/story/solo-phone-x2-morning.png.

The viewer has no close affordance, no position indicator and no badge naming who generated the photo; it is a bare contain-fit image on ground. A 32px surface close circle top right (like the recap) and a small '2 of 6' label would make it read as a shipped viewer. docs/shots/story/viewer-phone-x2-morning.png.

Voice card play button on demo notes is a dead control (no src, tap does nothing, no feedback). Acceptable for demo data but spec 5.3 says the audio is real and playable; the seed should carry an audio file for at least the Marco and Jonas notes. docs/shots/critic/st-solo-tap-voiceplay.png.

issues.text: Quote beat legibility: the 20/600 white quote sits on a radial scrim (rgba(11,11,15,0.55) to 0 at 72%) that is only as big as the 342x94 text box, so on a bright photo the words land on raw sunset orange (background luminance up to 199/255 behind the top line, about 1.6:1 there; 5.6:1 at the median). Rule 5 says text on photos always sits on a scrim. Fix: while a quote beat plays, add a real middle band to the layer scrim (for example rgba(11,11,15,0.5) across the middle 40% of the height, 600ms in with the quote) or make the radial at least 2x the text box in both axes and 0.7 at center.

Closing flashes beat 0: App renders the popped entry as a fresh <Recap> instance for the 600ms slide-out (layer(leaving) with key 'leaving'), so closing from beat 3 shows the tag-cover photo with an empty progress bar sliding away (shot taken 200ms after tapping close at beat 3), and in the real app the song lookup fires again (/__music requests went 2 to 4 on close) and a second looped Audio can start for 600ms. Owner: core App.jsx, keep the same element instance for the leaving layer (freeze the rendered node, do not re-call layer()). Recap-side mitigation if core will not change: do nothing on mount when the container has class leaving is not possible from props, so this needs the integrator.

Reduced motion breaks the player: tokens.css's global `* { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important }` collapses the 900ms crossfade to a hard cut and snaps the current progress segment to fully played the moment a beat starts (at beat 1 the second bar reads as done, shot taken 5.3s in with reducedMotion: reduce). Spec 2.7 says movement becomes opacity-only, not removed. Owner: core (scope the rule to transforms, or exclude .rc-layer and .rc-progress b); the recap's own reduced-motion block is correct but cannot beat the !important.

Spotify mark is faked: a 19px 1.5px line icon clipped inside a 15px green circle. At 3x you can see a dark ring around the disc edge and hairline waves instead of the solid green disc with bold dark bars in the reference (#i-spotify). Core should add a filled Spotify mark to Icons.jsx (the story song row needs it at 26px too); the recap then drops .rc-spot's clipping hack.

Caption pill hard-swaps its name and avatar the instant a beat changes while the photo behind it is still 900ms into its dissolve (mid-crossfade shot shows 'Elena' over a 55% blended Greece/New York frame). Let the caption move with the content: either key the pill per beat and give it the same 12px rise as the quote, or delay the swap to the crossfade midpoint.
Progress fill has a square leading edge inside a 2px-radius track (visible at 3x on the fifth segment). Round the fill (border-radius: inherit) or clip with the track's radius on both ends.

Dead air: beat 2 of the Greece recap is 32 seconds on one still photo with a demo voice that has no audio and no transcript shown, half of the 67s film. The brief allowed it, so this is for the data owner: cap a demo-voice beat at 8s in the seed or recapOf, or let the recap show the transcript as the quote when voice.src is null.

Isabel's caption avatar is a dark surface disc with an initial (persona p5 has photo: null) sitting on the scrim pill, which reads flatter than the reference's photo avatar. Data owner: give p5 an avatar_url in the Isabel space. Also, photos are 823x900 and are upscaled about 1.9x on a 2x phone (and further by the 1.08 zoom), so beat 0 looks soft; 1200px-tall seed assets would fix it.

recap.notes: Gauntlet: 30 shots, 0 failed, 0 console/page errors, 0 failed requests, ready 919 to 1249ms (docs/shots/recap/summary.json). Contract: props db id nav onClose as in ARCHITECTURE 5; imports only react, core (Avatar, Icons), data/select, data/api, lib/photos, own folder; no localStorage/window writes (it reads location.search at module scope for showcase freezing, a read only). Verified by my own Playwright probes: progress 2.5px gap 4 white 0.35 / played #fff, current fill linear over the beat via CSS animation; close 32px surface circle with an 18px 1.5px Close; caption 24px avatar + 13/600 Geist on rgba(11,11,15,0.66); credit 10.5/600 letter-spacing 0.6 with a 15px green mark, Spotify green used nowhere else; photo object-fit cover with a 1.0 to 1.08 zoom on the beat length with the one ease; a true two-layer 900ms dissolve (mid frame at opacity 0.55, under layer held at 1.08); tap right advanced 1->2->3, tap left went back, center did nothing; the 8-beat Greece recap ended by itself after 67s with no end card; close pops the stack. Quote beat: 20/600 white centered, two lines, 4-line clamp, enters with a 12px rise. Copy: only names and 'Title · Artist', no emoji, no em dashes. Colors: scrim gradient matches the reference player exactly, ground #101014 behind. Not verified: real song playback and ducking (iTunes CDN unreachable from the sandbox, the player runs silent as specified), video beats (none in the seed), voice beats with real audio (none in the seed). Score 7.5: the mechanics and layout match the mockup closely and it runs clean, but the quote beat fails the scrim rule on bright photos and the exit/reduced-motion behaviour, both rooted in core, are visible defects in this module's experience; not a pass until rank 1 is fixed and the two core issues are resolved or scoped around.

issues.text: Every p5 shot shows the keeper greeting 'Keep a moment, Isabel.' twice, stacked. src/data/threads-p5.json carries greet_2026-09-03 and greet_2026-09-04 (the file keeps collecting real-clock greetings because the dev thread middleware writes through in showcase mode). Delete the stale row and make showcase runs read-only for thread and db writes. Core-owned data, but the user sees it on the capture sheet.

Tapping Save now in the forming showcase scene persisted a real memory (p5_mtl76njs5vp 'Thursday morning') into the p5 dev db and four rows into the checked-in src/data/threads-p5.json; after that, every open shot showed orphan 'Saved as one memory' and 'Who was with you?' bubbles with no card (the bundled Isabel space does not contain the memory). I restored the file and deleted the memory by hand. Showcase scenes must never write (guard addMemory/appendMessage behind the showcase flag or make /__threads and /__db no-ops when ?showcase is set).

The sticky month pill collides with the card beneath it: 'May 2026' sits on top of 'Grandma's laughter' (title unreadable) in big-buttons-off, on 'Siv after the groomer' in open/recording, on 'Morning swim' at phoneSmall, and 'September 2026' sits on the 'Keep a moment, Isabel.' bubble in forming evening and after a save. Either give the thread top padding equal to the pill height plus 8, or drop the sticky positioning (v2 glass pill or not, rule 15 says no colliding elements).

Gray text tiers on the Dawn sheet: month pills, memory card meta ('Jun 14 · Amsterdam'), the forming line '2 moments · one memory', the voice duration and the Moment icon all render #6B7280, the placeholder #9CA3AF. Spec 2.2 and rule 3: Dawn text is slate #1F2937 at full saturation, hierarchy by size and weight only. The reference forming bar is slate at 500.

A short thread is top-anchored: after the mic smoke and save the four rows sit under the header and 300px of empty gradient separate them from the dock. The reference pins the conversation to the bottom, just above the forming bar and buttons (photo bubble margin-top:auto). Use justify-content:flex-end or margin-top:auto on the first group so the latest rows always sit above the dock.

The thread hard-clips under the transparent header: in every open/recording shot a memory card is sliced flat at y=160 right beneath 'Capture' with no fade and no spacing, reading as unfinished. Give .cs-body a mask-image fade (16 to 24px) or a glass header background, and 8px of thread top padding so the first card never touches the header.

Perf: 5.3MB transferred on every capture shot. The twelve 56px memory card thumbnails load the 900px Isabel originals (mem-01 332KB, tag-cover 281KB, mem-05 265KB ...) with loading=auto, so about 2.5MB of images are fetched for cards that are scrolled off screen. Convention (ARCHITECTURE 7): loading="lazy" below the fold. memories-p2.json (180KB) also loads for a p5 session (core).

Label text is 13/500 (legacy .type-label) on the forming bar, month pills, meta and Save now. Rule 4: four sizes 30/20/16/12, label is 12/600. The new v3 forming line and Save now should use --type-label.

The forming bar carries an extra unlabeled gray target icon (Moment, 36px) right of Save now; the reference bar ends with Save now. The target is 36px (rule 12: 44px) and the icon has no visible meaning. Hide it or give it its label.

A memory saved inside the frozen showcase clock (now=2026-09-04, Friday) was titled 'Thursday morning' and dated 'Sep 3': the engine uses the real Date.now() instead of the app's now. The save path should read the same clock as the greeting.

Recording state feedback is faint: the pressed big mic only shifts white to cream and the bar shows a small dot, 0:03 and a five-bar wave. No 'slide left to cancel' hint. An AAA hold-to-talk state should be unmistakable at a glance.

The keeper greeting 'Keep a moment, Isabel.' is not in the v3 copy bank (first launch line is 'What do you want to remember? Send a photo, voice note or thought.') and is an imperative (rule 13: questions never demands). The evening 'How do you feel today?' prompt lands inside the forming window between the photos and the forming bar, reading as part of the memory.
Header avatar renders the initial 'I' on a white circle; the reference shows a photo avatar. p5 has no portrait by design (core), so either add a portrait for the demo world or accept the initial.

capture.notes: Full gauntlet: 50 shots, 0 failed, 0 console/page errors, 0 failed requests, readyMs 929 to 1438. Measured against spec: close 34px white, title 16/600 slate, avatar 30, big circles 58 with 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), labels 11/600 slate, gap 32, icons stroke 1.5 round caps, sheet radius 32 top and transform 600ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), dock padding uses env(safe-area-inset-bottom). issues.text: The portrait never renders: .pf-portrait computes to 76x0 in every shot (probe: h=0). Root cause: .pf is a flex column with height:100% and overflow-y:auto, so every child is a shrinkable flex item; the portrait has overflow:hidden which makes its automatic minimum size 0, and it collapses. Spec 5.6 lists the portrait first; the mock has a 72px photo above the name. The avatar edit flow is equally blind: after picking a file, Save/Cancel appear under the header with no picture (docs/shots/critic/pf-avatar-picked.png), and after saving the new photo is still invisible (docs/shots/critic/pf-avatar-saved.png). Fix: give every .pf child flex-shrink:0 (or make .pf display:block and keep flex only where needed), then verify .pf-portrait is 76x76 in the probe.

Answering a question is broken by the same flex-shrink bug: tapping a question keeps the row at min-height 48 while its content (label 16 + input 23 + actions 24 + gaps) needs about 75px; the input and the Save/Skip buttons render outside the row and are painted over by the next white row, so the user sees a bold label, no input, no placeholder and no actions (docs/shots/critic/pf-question-edit.png). Typing puts the text on the row's bottom edge and Save stays hidden (docs/shots/critic/pf-question-typed.png). Also give the input a placeholder from the copy bank (What do you remember? exists) so an empty edit state reads as an input.

Contract violation: src/profile/index.jsx lines 31 and 117 read and write localStorage directly (memmory.profile.questions.<pid>) for the three question answers. ARCHITECTURE.md section 5: modules never write to storage except through the actions they are given; Profile is given setSetting. Route the answers through settings (setSetting('questions', {...}) or one key per question) and read them from settings.

The gauge does not read as a gauge. The v2 mock (memmory-design-v2/design-direction-v2.html .gauge) draws a pale #EFE9E0 track for the full arc and paints the heat gradient only up to the value, needle plus value word plus streak line. Built version paints the full heat arc always, so the arc says nothing and only a small needle carries the value; with the streak line gone the card is mostly empty white (128px art in a 132px tall card). Restore the track + partial heat arc; keep the value word; if the streak line has to be truthful, draw the card tighter (padding 14, art 116x64 like the mock) so it is not a white void.
